description: Skills shipped with the claw distribution. Each entry's `tier_policy` controls how it's installed: 'invariant' = mirror into <co>/foundation/skills/ on every co update (framework owns it); 'template' = seed-copy into <co>/workspace/skills/ once at co create, operator owns it from then on (only re-seeded on explicit `claw skill reseed`). Default when omitted is 'invariant' for backwards compatibility. Content lives under res/foundation/<name>/.

tools.description: Pedagogy for the agent's craft surface: when to forge vs compose, decision trees, gotchas-flywheel discipline. Seeded into <co>/workspace/skills/tools/ at create time so each company can refine the lore as agents accumulate experience (without forking the framework). Underlying tool API (find/forge/update/share/remove) stays framework-canonical in the binary.
